aoi.description: Select the area you want to analyse. All subsequent steps will be clipped to this boundary.

variables.description: Add input variables for the risk model.
variables.confirm_remove_message: Remove '{name}' from this project? This cannot be undone.
variables.confirm_remove_base_warning: It is the base raster's source, so the base raster will also be cleared.
variables.error_no_project: No active project — complete the AOI step first.
variables.error_base_raster_reset: Base raster was reset because its source layer '{name}' changed — re-set it in Step 3 — Process.
variables.error_base_raster_removed: Base raster was reset because its source layer '{name}' was removed — re-set it in Step 3 — Process.

process.description: Download layers, set the base raster + projection, then reproject and rasterize all variables.
process.error_no_base: Set a base raster above to enable processing.

postprocess.description: Derive new variables from the processed, aligned layers: change detection (loss/gain) and edge/distance transforms.
postprocess.change_help_text: Pick two presence masks (1 = present, 0 = absent) of the same phenomenon at two different years — same or different sources. Output: 1 = event, 0 = stable, 255 = nodata.

dataset.description: Bundle a target and feature variables into a dataset for model training.
dataset.error_features_required: Select at least one feature variable.
dataset.confirm_remove_message: Remove dataset '{name}' from this project? This cannot be undone.

sampling.description: Draw a persistent, named sample from a raster variable. Samples are selectable in Train (Step 7) and can be added to the map.
sampling.adapt_label: Adapt allocation to observed deforestation rate
sampling.error_invalid_spacing: Enter a positive distance between points (m).
sampling.error_toggle_map: Could not toggle sample on map: {exc}
sampling.confirm_remove_message: Delete sample '{name}'? This removes it from the project and deletes its files. This cannot be undone.

inference.description: Select a trained model and a dataset, then run inference.
inference.model_select_no_data: No trained models available. Train one in Step 7.
inference.dataset_select_no_data: No datasets registered. Create one in Step 5.
inference.pred_name_exists_warning: ⚠ A prediction named '{name}' already exists — running overwrites it.
inference.error_name_required: Enter a prediction name (letters, numbers, - or _).
inference.confirm_delete_predictions_message_one: Delete {n} prediction raster from this run? This removes it from the project and deletes the file. This cannot be undone.
inference.confirm_delete_predictions_message_other: Delete {n} prediction rasters from this run? This removes them from the project and deletes the files. This cannot be undone.
inference.confirm_remove_job_message: Remove this inference job from the list?
inference.confirm_overwrite_message: A prediction named '{name}' already exists. Running will overwrite its raster(s) and registry entry. This cannot be undone.
inference.error_map_toggle: Could not toggle prediction on map: {exc}

evaluation.description: Score selected maps against one chosen truth (observed deforestation + forest-at-start + interval) so maps from different datasets are comparable. Each run is saved below — click it to view the table. Indices: MedAE / R² / RMSE / wRMSE.
evaluation.interval_hint: Auto-parsed from the truth variable name; editable.
evaluation.maps_no_data: No predictions registered. Run inference in Step 8.
evaluation.csizes_hint: One or more sizes, comma-separated (e.g. 100, 300, 1000). Each adds a row per map.
evaluation.error_no_predictions: No predictions available yet — run inference first.
evaluation.error_no_variables: No processed variables yet — complete earlier steps first.
evaluation.error_select_metric: Select at least one metric to show.

summary.error_no_project: No project open. Create or load a project first.

train.description: Select a model, configure its parameters, and launch training.
train.dataset_select_no_data: No datasets. Create one in Step 5 — Dataset.
train.sample_select_no_data: No samples. Generate one in Step 6 — Sampling.
train.variables_info_no_dataset: Select a dataset above to list its features.
train.variables_info_no_features: Dataset '{dataset}' has no features to choose from.
train.variables_select_no_data: No features in the selected dataset.
train.error_name_required: Enter a model name (letters, numbers, - or _).
train.error_layer_not_in_dataset: '{label}' = '{val}' is not a feature in dataset '{dataset}'.
train.confirm_delete_model_message: Delete model '{key}'? This removes it from the project and deletes its files. This cannot be undone.
train.confirm_remove_job_message: Remove this training job from the list?
train.confirm_overwrite_message: A model named '{key}' already exists. Training will replace it and delete its files. This cannot be undone.
train.model_name_exists_warning: ⚠ A model named '{key}' already exists — training overwrites it.
